scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door (Apenas a vizinha da casa ao lado)
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron (General de avental)
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, F2 sits with her ankle on pillows directing M4's bread kneading and F1's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre (Cenouras ao milímetro)
scenes.summary: M3 chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while M4 and F2 tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine (Preparando o Quarto Nove)
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, F1, F3, and M1 lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away (Guarde o discurso)
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, M2 nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until F1 and M1 convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp (O carimbo do patrimônio)
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks F3 to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen (Brinde na cozinha)
scenes.summary: Listening to F3's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, F2, M3, and M4 clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate (A melodia no portão)
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, M2, F1, and F3 learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with M2's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
